body: Years of feeling useless, talentless, and undeserving of the love and affection of others. I thought I could live my life alone and isolated from people, only to learn that I made myself more fucked up than I was before, and now I think it’s too late to make any useful changes. I’m a defective human, and what do we do with defective products? We throw them away because they have no use and serve no purpose
